stories.title: Ryan Fox Wins The Open Championship — New Zealand's First Major Champion

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Ryan Fox birdied the 72nd hole to win The Open Championship.

10-under par. 270 total.

First major of his career.

First New Zealand golfer to win a major in the modern era.

The Claret Jug is going to Auckland.

#TheOpen #Golf #RyanFox

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Final leaderboard from Royal Birkdale:

🏆 Ryan Fox — -10
2. Cameron Young — -9
3. Sam Burns — -8
T4. Scheffler / Fleetwood — -7

Fox birdied 18 to win by one.

A major champion was born on the Birkdale links. 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿

#TheOpen #BritishOpen

stories.title: Michael Kim Shoots 59 at the 3M Open — PGA Tour's 16th Sub-60 Round in History

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Michael Kim shot a 59 at the 3M Open on Friday.

The 16th sub-60 round in PGA Tour history.

He now leads the tournament at -14, three clear of the field.

Rounds 3 and 4 are this weekend.

History is in the air at TPC Twin Cities. ⛳

#PGATour #3MOpen

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Michael Kim: 69 in Round 1.

Then: 59 in Round 2.

128 total. -14. Three-shot lead at the 3M Open.

The rest of the field is watching a different tournament right now.

Two rounds to go. Will he close it out?

#PGATour #3MOpen #Golf

stories.title: Open Championship Debrief — DeChambeau's Penalty and What Fox's Win Means for New Zealand Golf

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Bryson DeChambeau received a two-stroke penalty at The Open.

He later said he "wished he would have given it more on the weekend."

Ryan Fox shot 62 in Round 3, birdied 18 in Round 4, and took the Claret Jug.

Royal Birkdale gave us a classic. #TheOpen #Golf
